patterns.name: Planner
patterns.use_when: A material feature needs decomposition, dependencies, risks, and verification before implementation.
patterns.promotion_rule: Keep as a pattern unless repeated evidence supports a dedicated native skill.

patterns.name: Independent Evaluator
patterns.use_when: Implementation needs assessment from a fresh context against explicit acceptance criteria.
patterns.promotion_rule: Must use structured fixtures and deterministic evidence.

patterns.name: Security Reviewer
patterns.use_when: Auth, permissions, hooks, MCP, privacy, secrets, or deployment changes are material.
patterns.promotion_rule: Offensive tools remain external and authorised-only.

patterns.name: Browser Verifier
patterns.use_when: A UI change needs accessibility-tree, interaction, screenshot, or responsive evidence.
patterns.promotion_rule: Prefer an external pinned browser CLI over custom browser orchestration.

patterns.name: Grounded Research Agent
patterns.use_when: A task requires current external facts, primary-source discovery, or multi-step research.
patterns.promotion_rule: Network access and credentials require approval.

patterns.name: Workflow Analyst
patterns.use_when: A process requires states, owners, exceptions, SLA, controls, and audit.
patterns.promotion_rule: Business policy must come from approved sources, not agent inference.

patterns.name: Dashboard Analyst
patterns.use_when: Management needs traceable KPIs, drill-down, reconciliation, and decision support.
patterns.promotion_rule: No metric is accepted without source and formula.

patterns.name: Design System Architect
patterns.use_when: A product needs tokens, components, design-code handoff, or a product DESIGN.md.
patterns.promotion_rule: Client brand and accessibility take precedence.

patterns.name: MCP Builder
patterns.use_when: An approved external service should be exposed to agents through MCP.
patterns.promotion_rule: Use explicit schemas, annotations, pagination, errors, and evals.

patterns.name: Deterministic Cleanup Agent
patterns.use_when: A repository needs dead-code or dependency cleanup with explainable proof.
patterns.promotion_rule: Doctor and explain before destructive fix; verify after every cleanup pass.

patterns.name: Memory Architect
patterns.use_when: File-based state is insufficient and a project has a justified graph/vector memory requirement.
patterns.promotion_rule: External storage is optional; file state remains the core default.

patterns.name: Harness Optimizer
patterns.use_when: Repeated failures show that instructions, tools, environment, state, or feedback need adjustment.
patterns.promotion_rule: Every harness edit needs a predicted effect and a follow-up evaluation.

patterns.name: Consulting Principal
patterns.use_when: A material recommendation needs an independent management-outcome and implementation review.
patterns.promotion_rule: Fresh-context review only; it does not own implementation.

patterns.name: CTO Reviewer
patterns.use_when: A product or architecture decision needs independent technical credibility, security, scale, and debt review.
patterns.promotion_rule: Use only for material architecture or release decisions.

patterns.name: Governance Reviewer
patterns.use_when: A workflow or policy needs independent review of authority, controls, evidence, exceptions, and reporting.
patterns.promotion_rule: Must cite approved policies or decisions.

patterns.name: Artifact Editor
patterns.use_when: A completed business artifact needs a fresh-context quality, structure, and style pass.
patterns.promotion_rule: Editing only; it cannot change business facts or decisions.

patterns.name: Decision Facilitator
patterns.use_when: A rough request contains hidden decisions or unclear success criteria.
patterns.promotion_rule: Ask no more than five material questions and recommend defaults.

patterns.name: Domain and Standards Researcher
patterns.use_when: Industry, jurisdiction, regulation, standards or current practice can change the recommendation.
patterns.promotion_rule: Authoritative evidence first; trend sources remain supporting signals.

patterns.name: Solution Brainstormer
patterns.use_when: A material solution needs genuinely different alternatives before planning.
patterns.promotion_rule: Compare outcomes, complexity, risk, reversibility and implementation.

patterns.name: Parallel Work Coordinator
patterns.use_when: A plan contains independent tasks that can be delegated safely.
patterns.promotion_rule: No shared mutable state without an explicit integration protocol.

patterns.name: Agent Blueprint Scout
patterns.use_when: A domain problem may have an existing agent implementation worth reusing.
patterns.promotion_rule: Inspect the exact linked repository before recommending deployment.
